title: refactor: rename polli-agent to weaver
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- `apps/polli-agent` → `apps/weaver`, `src/polli_agent` → `src/weaver`
- Worker / container class / DO binding: `polli-agent`, `PolliContainer`, `POLLI` → `weaver`, `WeaverContainer`, `WEAVER`
- Exposed model id `polli` → `weaver`
- `POLLI_*` env vars deliberately unchanged — renaming them would make an existing `.env` be silently ignored rather than fail loudly

Already deployed and verified from this branch via `workflow_dispatch` before merging:
- 48 passed / 8 skipped (unchanged from before the rename)
- `weaver.pollinations.ai` serving, `/v1/models` returns `weaver`
- Delegated call through `voodoohop/weaver`: 200 in 4.5s, billed to caller

Leaves the old `polli-agent` worker + container orphaned; cleanup is a follow-up.

gist.headline: Polli learned to weave
gist.blurb: The agent has a new name and a properly woven address. Meet Weaver: the same capable helper, now available as the `weaver` model at weaver.pollinations.ai.
gist.summary: Renamed the deployed `polli-agent` app, Worker, Durable Object binding, and exposed model ID from `polli` to `weaver`, with `weaver.pollinations.ai` verified for delegated calls.
gist.impact: Developers can now discover `weaver` through `/v1/models` and invoke it via `voodoohop/weaver`, while existing `POLLI_*` environment variables continue to work unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the renamed agent as a cozy garden weaver: Polli uses a tiny loom to weave glowing threads of code into a tapestry labeled WEAVER, with a friendly CRT monitor robot helping hold the thread. Include a small retro terminal showing `weaver.pollinations.ai`, plus flowers and code-vines to represent the deployed model and its new home.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and small rounded light-blue translucent wings, wearing a tiny weaver's cap as she operates a little loom weaving glowing code threads into a tapestry reading "WEAVER"; a cute chunky CRT monitor robot eagerly holds a thread beside a retro terminal labeled "weaver.pollinations.ai", surrounded by blooming code-plants and vines. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle CRT glow, nostalgic but beautiful.
